name: @bossnyumba/document-reconciliation
description: Cross-document fact reconciliation for real-estate paperwork. A tenant or owner submits several documents for one matter (national ID, TIN certificate, lease agreement, rent receipts, bank + M-PESA statements, condition surveys); the brain projects each to a normalized fact bag, then runs pairwise matchers (Levenshtein names, E164 phones, Jaccard addresses, ISO dates, amounts, bank accounts) to surface mismatches before a decision. STRICT mismatches block; SOFT mismatches flag for human review. Adds per-field Platt confidence calibration, a self-consistency vote over extraction shots, per-issuer layout fingerprints, and EML/MSG/M-PESA-SMS/QR extractors. Extends @bossnyumba/document-analysis by consuming its extractor output shape. Pure functions + injected ports — no DB/SDK/env. Default-OFF feature flag with a single wireDocumentReconciliation() composition export.
